defs.def: a son of your son or daughter 孙子；外孙

ex.s: This hit home for me as I was sitting with my 2-year-old grandson on a sofa over the Spring Festival holiday.
ex.t: 当春节假期我和两岁的孙子坐在沙发上时，这让我深有感触。

ex.s: Picture this: my grandson sitting on my lap as I hold the book in front so he can see the pictures.
ex.t: 想象一下：我的孙子坐在我腿上，我把书举在他面前让他看到图片。

ex.s: But I will make sure my 2-year-old grandson sees it on his tablet.
ex.t: 但我会确保我两岁的孙子在他的平板电脑上看到它。

ex.s: Mr Smith owned this oil painting until the early 1990s, ______ he gave it to his grandson.
ex.t: Smith先生拥有这幅油画直到20世纪90年代初，______他把它送给了他的孙子。

ex.s: The grandfather advises his grandson to go to university and 7______________at the same time.
ex.t: 祖父建议他的孙子去上大学，同时……

ex.s: I got my grandson to show me how to send an email and search the web,whichI now love.
ex.t: 我让孙子教我怎么发电子邮件和上网搜索，我现在非常喜欢这些。
